# Anandalakshmi Ayurveda Retreat

> > Authentic Ayurveda retreat in Kovalam, Kerala offering traditional Panchakarma detoxification, rejuvenation therapies, and holistic healing by the Arabian Sea.

Anandalakshmi Ayurveda Retreat is located in Chowara, Kovalam, near Trivandrum, Kerala. The retreat specializes in personalized Ayurvedic treatments including Panchakarma, dosha balancing, yoga and meditation, with experienced physicians like Dr. M.S. Baiju providing traditional healing therapies for wellness, stress management, and rejuvenation.
